title: Build And Test Runs Screen
body:
Notes:

Mapping between current code and the new UI

BP Definition will be Process Template

BP Execution, Business Process Execution, and Business Process → Process Run

Process Family, Process Type, Process Name → Process Family

Process Name → Process Sub Family

We need in the navigation above a new tab called Build And Testg Activity (base don current code we need to place it first before the Business Processes tab) first thjign after project name)


Row 1:

https://www.figma.com/design/8Z7emdDFkZapK3nmVP2HsA/MxEvolve?node-id=5162-181947&m=dev

In Bold List of Build & Test runs on the left, and on the right we have the My Builds filter (similar to exisitng my executios) and the Run Button to Run new CI Process

Currenltly we call this endpoint wth the added ownerPhrase when selected, the ownerPhrase is the logged in user https://mxevolve-dev.cd.murex.com/gateway/api/v1/projects/b9d73257-6872-4cd8-92ba-b74223c940e9/business-process/executions/ci-process?page=0&pageSize=10&ownerPhrase=mxflow-dev-admin&hidden=false&sort=startDate,desc

The code currently lives here in the legacy compoennets web/libs/domains/business-process/feature/src/lib/build-and-test/build-and-test-executions/legacy/ci-process-executions

We need to migrater to new way of writng code relying on ag grid singals, and new angular features and remove all code smells without breaking any existing funcntionality. The changes should just be visual by migraitng to ag grid and code wise to make it more readable. no fufnctionality whether ffilters, authorization, feature flags or anythign  else should be afffected.

Also there's an issue ow each time, this is called https://mxevolve-dev.cd.murex.com/gateway/api/v1/projects/b9d73257-6872-4cd8-92ba-b74223c940e9/business-process/executions/ci-process I get 10 (page size) calls to this https://mxevolve-dev.cd.murex.com/gateway/api/v1/issue-tracking/projects/b9d73257-6872-4cd8-92ba-b74223c940e9/project-details most times it is same project id. We need to fix that


In the new table it will be a bit different like the figma here MxEvolve – Figma,

We have Active Runs which only shows BPs (mainly Process since in this feature we are migrating CI Process only) with status running and pending Input. With Show History button that shows stuff with other sttauses. Note here the data is paginated from abckend with backend pagination. So maybe figma/screenshot doens't reflect it 100%. This is how it will look like when Show history is expanded MxEvolve – Figma . The figma might contains filters and fields not in the cuyrrent table or misses some that are some. I want to migrate the same columns with the same order of columns and with any available filter to maintain it. For the Actions column I want it sticky. I have a repush BP button, check the existing available one here in legacy code   web/apps/shell/src/app/global-operations/business-process-executions/global-ops-business-process-executions-table.component.html.

The mxevolve-business-process-execution-repush-modal-opener needs to be copied into the new architecture and ruse it in the new component. For the abort button we already have one in the new architecture migrated to be reused web/libs/domains/business-process/composite-widget/src/lib/execution-abort-button




We also call project details endpoints

  • Check here the use of mxevolve-my-executions-toggle and migrate to new architecture web/libs/domains/business-process/feature/src/lib/validation-process/validation-process-executions/validation-process-executions-table/validation-process-executions-table.component.html
  • Clicking on the Run Button will open this dialog
    • MxEvolve – Figma
    • Thia dialog that shows Available Templates is equivalent the the available processes table compoennt we have with the filter preapplied to the Build & Test Process.
    • This is the old service that needs to be migrated to new architecture with its tests and contratc tests under data-access library web/apps/shell/src/app/business-process/business-process-definition/business-process-definition-table/business-process-definition-table.component.ts
    • This is the API endpoint called https://mxevolve-dev.cd.murex.com/gateway/api/v1/projects/b9d73257-6872-4cd8-92ba-b74223c940e9/business-process/definitions?extendable=false&executable=true
    • Filtering is done on the UI side, here we filter by 'Build & Test Process' (Make sure here backend in not paginated base don ym check and current code on uyi wirtten it is not)
    • Select Sub-Activity in the screenshot call it it Select Sub Family
    • For the Sub Activity Dropdown in the image call   its values are from the list of here hardcoded 
    • "Configuration Build & Test" , "RTP Enrichment" "RTP Build" "RTP Test Adaptation" "Technical Reseed" "On Demand Backport"
    • On select form sub acitivty dropdown also filter
    • Make table pagable with size 5 
    • The Run button is equivalent to the "Execute Action" (to be migrated from here to new architecture + new clean code web/apps/shell/src/app/business-process/business-process-definition/business-process-definition-execute-modal-opener/business-process-definition-execute-modal-opener.component.ts)
    • Clicking on the Run will reuse the same dialog but open a new template inside of it (override the old, with a back button) Check Figma MxEvolve – Figma
    • The dialog with multiple views/templates and back could be a generic common components in libs/shared library
    • Check this compoennt for reference web/libs/features/business-process/src/lib/build-and-test/build-and-test-process-definition-executor/build-and-test-definition-executor.component.ts
    • If you notice, in the screenshots/Figma
      • The Dialog Title is the name of the Template/ Busoness PRcess Definition (in old naming)
      • Inside it, there is a panel with the {name of the template} Details, and clicking in the panel will open another view/template in the dialog component we have with details 
      •  In the body of the dialog:
        • The user can add User Stories
        • There is an input field for user input, the validation is hidden behind feature flag check web/libs/ui/inputs/src/lib/user-story-input/add-user-story-modal/add-user-story-modal.component.ts for reference on the logic of enabling the vlaidaiton on stories
        • There is no search (the serach icon from screenshot is not needed)
        • When a story is added, we show it like this MxEvolve – Figma , the button is still shown on the same row
        •  Adding other stories will be it to the row under
        • When Clicking on Run we should see all of the inputs and dialog should scroll horizontally to make them all appear (the screenshot shows additional settings ignore it)
        • There are two formats for this form this web/libs/features/business-process/src/lib/build-and-test/build-and-test-process-definition-executor/build-and-test-definition-executor.component.ts and this web/libs/features/business-process/src/lib/backport/backport-definition-executor/backport-definition-executor.component.ts and they are used by this web/apps/shell/src/app/business-process/business-process-definition/business-process-definition-execute-modal-opener/business-process-definition-execute-modal-opener.component.htmlin the legacy mfe. We need to migrate these two with the new UI design based on what is shown in the screenshots, the screenshots may not be complete by they can show the design language so refer to the svcreenshots to build the rest
        • It is important not to miss any fields on existing funcitronality we have when doing the migration
        • Preferrably here they are still indiividual components for the two different inputs
        • Also, the way these should be rendered whether the mxevolve-build-and-test-definition-executor or mxevolve-backport-definition-executor should not depend on viewchild like we currently have you should rely on new angular features like signals and so to do the migration
        • Notice there is logic to see what inputs to view or not based on what is already prefilled in the business porcess definition
        • These are done using intializeForm now and so on, I need to migrate into a clean code probably here input/output using signals can be used. To Decide whether to show a field or not and how to show there is now web/libs/features/business-process/src/lib/definition-input/definition-input.component.ts.
          • We can see how web/libs/features/business-process/src/lib/definition-input/definition-input.component.ts works and see the different cases and for each field check the logic whether to display or not.
        • The logic here lives in mxevolve-definitoin-input which is a generic compoennt and we pass input to it. We need to remove this and just check each field for each family or sub family the logic behind it and migrate it. Mainly each family can have its own component except build and test we need to differentiate only the backport sub family
    • One thing noticed is that when the user is in the build part there is this arrow beside business definiton name when clicked it should show the prefilled input in the business process defintion (expand). So as we were saying when the user wants to do a "build" or execute a business definitoin, we show him the input based on a logic.
      • Here I would like to show the prefilled fields, we do not have exact design so we should udr same design language we have been using in the new code and for the component I have a design for in this feature.
      • To display Business Process Executionb details, we currenlt yhave a generic component web/libs/ui/inputs/src/lib/input-view-resolver/input-view-resolver.component.ts that takes a map and display fields. This is a legacy component and it was done for the sake of generalziization under the assumption that we might have veru dufferent Business process types/families but now we only have 3 families validAYION, UUGRADE, AND BUILD AND TEST, ANMD THE SUB FMAILIES ARE VERY SIMILAR ONLY BUILD AND TEST have a sub family that is backjport very different so it has its onw components. Based, on that, and based on the Create Business Process Definition for each component, I want to remove this generic legacy component use and probably for the Build And Test since now in this feature I want  to migrate build and test have 2 versions with hardcoded fields for the normal build and tets and backport basded on the fields we have wehn creating a busioness process definition. Here we should also only show on expand the bp definiton that are prefilled, and the input down we are showing has the inputs that is not prefilled


    • It is important after this migration, first to keep existing code, we are adding this as a new route
    • Prefer to use minimal components and place them under the right domain in the new architecture





  • Migrate The Table With Filters (use AG Grid for table) + My Builds filter (which is similar to current My Executions) 1.5sp
    • Two Tables  ASctive runs show Running and Pending Input BP Executions
    • Clicking on show previous, shows the other BPs
    • Paginated tables both (pagination is already in the backend)
    • Default page size 5 for active 10 for inactive
    • Maintain the same colum,ns we currently have
  • Add actions bar column that include abort (already have it in new arhcitecture) + repush bp (not found in new arhcitecture copy same logic from legacy and place serivces and compoennt in their resppective place) 2sp
    • Legacy Repush opener is here web/apps/shell/src/app/business-process/business-process-execution/business-process-execution-repush-modal-opener/business-process-execution-repush-modal-opener.component.ts
  • Create a Generic Dialog Component 2sp  

    • single modal dialog that can display more than one internal page/view without closing.

      • the dialog opens normally on page 1
      • the user performs an action inside the dialog
      • instead of closing the dialog or opening another modal, the dialog navigates internally to page 2
      • the user can then go back to page 1
      • the dialog remains the same dialog instance throughout
      • The dialog can support multiple pages
  • Dialog One 1.5sp
    • Get Business Process Definitions (not backend paginated)
    • Filter then by Build&Test
    • Show the  Sub Family dropdown with filter
    • Run button
  • Dialog 2:
    • Reviewers's dropdown + service from user managem,ent service 1sp (in backport inputs)
    • Configuration branch input with the chekc if its valid 0.5sp
    • Users to notify dropdown (same service as get users) 
    • Repository dropdown + its service 0.5sp
    • Scenario Definition Input 0.5
    • Infra Group input 0.5sp
    • Logic to detemrine what to display or not 1.5sp
    • Prepare skip environment 0.5sp
    • User stories id with chekc if valid + feature flag 1.5sp
    • Panel for activity details 2sp
    • Run button with its service 0.5sp



All migrated services when called form compoennet should use rxJS resource over explicit subscribe when possible

Error handling should be properly done, most times we are using toastMEssage showError to show an error. Iff existing code we are migrating has a special handling that showError doesn't make sense in we need to keep it the same
